{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
real_sales = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = real_sales[(real_sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (real_sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Verify the count of loyal completed orders
n_loyal_completed = len(loyal_completed)

# Print result and verification
mean_revenue, n_loyal_completed"}
